items.t: Said Oregon passed the strongest ban on the corporate practice of medicine in the country and that it is time to take that fight nationwide.
items.q: Oregon has shown that it’s possible to stand up to corporate profiteering in healthcare and win. Now it’s time to take that fight nationwide.

items.t: Said investing in an anchor institution like the Moda Center is about foresight, not nostalgia.
items.q: The Blazers are proof that something can be both emotionally meaningful and economically strategic. Investing in an anchor institution like this is not about nostalgia–it's about foresight.
